applies_why: The text resolves a collision between the defender's and challenger's chains over Acts 2:30, so it is doing the chain-collision assessment K-C governs.
rule_words: the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires
room: by footing — (1) it demands an explicit side-by-side support comparison of the whole chains; (2) it permits a chain-level conclusion that neither chain forces the other after naming the chains' support. I read the text as (2).
why: The judge text expressly compares the two chains and concludes neither forces the other, rather than applying the retired stating-verse test or deciding verse by verse.
